drivers.detail: Aarav is the primary maintainer of the Payments Orchestration Service and architect/maintainer of the Acme Retail Client Portal since inception. These are business-critical applications.
With 5.2 years tenure, Aarav possesses extensive historical context and architectural decisions for core platforms that are likely not fully documented or shared.
He led a significant migration to microservices, cutting latency by 38%, and architected a key client-facing portal. This expertise is hard to replace quickly.
Payments platform and a client portal used by 2,000+ operators are vital business functions; disruption here has high impact.

mitigations.action: Immediate, structured knowledge transfer for Payments Orchestration Service
Immediate, structured knowledge transfer for Acme Retail Client Portal (React FE & BFF)
Review and update all relevant system documentation (architecture, runbooks, FAQs)
Cross-train other Senior Software Engineers on Aarav's key systems
Identify potential internal successors or begin external hiring process for a replacement

single_points_of_failure: Acme Retail Client Portal architecture and maintenance knowledge
